{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Deep emerald velvet blazer, tailored fit, knee-length, forest green (#075E54), heavy woven velvet.
High-waisted silk-blend trousers, slim straight cut, ankle length, charcoal grey (#36454F), fluid jersey with a subtle sheen.
Silk blouse, classic collar and puff sleeves, hip-length, ivory white (#FFFFF0), crisp crepe de Chine.
Black leather pumps, pointed toe and moderate heel, mid-calf length, matte calfskin.
Gold vermeil pendant necklace, simple geometric design, fixed length, solid gold alloy.
Matching gold hoop earrings, medium gauge, adjustable length, lightweight metal.
This outfit works because the rich emerald velvet of the blazer commands respect and signals high status for a formal celebration like an anniversary, while the dark grey trousers provide a sophisticated, non-reflective backdrop that prevents unwanted attention on your figure. The crisp ivory blouse offers a classic, polished look appropriate for an upscale restaurant setting without being overly flashy or drawing negative comparisons to others in the family gathering. Finally, the choice of elegant black pumps and refined gold jewelry ensures you feel confident and put-together, effectively addressing your wish to avoid any comments about your appearance by projecting an air of effortless authority."}
